We are seeking a Full Stack Engineer to design, build, and ship AI-powered applications and tools that support key business functions across Product, Sales, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering. Full Stack Application Development

GenAI and AI Tooling

Productionization, Reliability, and Support

jobDescription:
Support Manager

Experience: 3+ years

Location: Remote / Work from Home

Salary (CTC): As per company standards

No. of Positions: 1

Reports To: Senior Manager-Customer Operations

Role Overview

The Support Manager will own end-to-end support delivery for the Cisco AI Tutor project, covering full L1, L2, and L3 support across a 24x7 model as per the project. This role is responsible for ticket operations, SLA performance, team training and performance management, shift coverage, and driving continuous service improvement, including automation-led efficiency gains. The Support Manager will be the primary point of contact for support escalations with Cisco and will work closely with Engineering, Product, and Emplay leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the support ticket system end-to-end, ensuring correct categorization, prioritization, and SLA adherence across L1, L2, and L3 tickets.
  • Generate and present Support SLA reports to stakeholders, tracking resolution times and performance against agreed SLAs.
  • Drive usage, adoption, and customer satisfaction surveys; analyse results and present findings and recommendations to leadership.
  • Design and implement Service Improvement plans based on ticket trend analysis, RCA findings, and customer feedback.
  • Coordinate shift handovers across the support team to ensure seamless 24x7 coverage.
  • Lead support team training programs and manage ongoing performance reviews for L1 and L2 engineers.
  • Manage day-to-day workload allocation across the support team, ensuring tickets-per-FTE and resolution time targets are met.
  • Drive automation and AI-based support initiatives aimed at improving ticket deflection and resolution efficiency.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for high-severity (P1/P2) incidents, coordinating with Engineering, Product, and the Cisco team through to resolution.
  • Oversee AWS CloudWatch monitoring (concurrent users, error rates, and related metrics) for proactive issue detection, working with Engineering on alerting and dashboards.
  • Own RCA documentation, knowledge base creation, and audit/compliance reporting for the project.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in technical support, with at least 1-2 years in a support management or team lead capacity.
  • Proven experience managing a support team (L1/L2/L3) in a 24x7 environment, preferably in SaaS, ITSM, or AI-based products.
  • Strong knowledge of ticketing/ITSM systems, SLA management, and reporting tools (Freshservice, Remedy, ServiceNow, Jira, or similar).
  • Strong proficiency with AWS Cloud services.
  • Basic to intermediate Python coding skills, for automation and data analysis.
  • General awareness of AI/ML concepts and conversational AI/chatbot platforms.
  • Familiarity with learning platforms / EdTech environments is a plus.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable interfacing directly with enterprise clients and internal Engineering/Product teams.
  • Demonstrated experience driving process improvement and automation initiatives within a support organization.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience managing distributed or remote support teams across rotating shifts.
  • Prior experience supporting enterprise B2B SaaS clients, ideally in EdTech or learning platforms.
  • Experience with cloud monitoring tools (CloudWatch or similar) and incident management frameworks.
  • Exposure to SOC 1 or similar audit/compliance evidence processes.

Role Summary

You'll build features used by leading enterprises across hiring, learning, employee engagement, and HR automation.

You will build new AI-powered product capabilities.

Prior hands-on GenAI experience is a plus, not a requirement. If you're a solid Python developer with curiosity about LLMs and AI — even from a personal project, hackathon, or self-learning — we want to9 hear from you.


What You'll Work On


  • Enterprise HRTech platform (LMS/HRMS modules)
  • FastAPI-based microservices
  • OpenAI APIs & LangChain-based features
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents
  • Resume intelligence & document search
  • LLM integrations for product features
  • Product development

Key Responsibilities


  • Develop backend services, APIs, and business logic in Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django).
  • Design and maintain modules for user management, workflows, reports, notifications, and document handling.
  • Work with SQL databases; write and optimise queries.
  • Write clean, reusable, well-documented, and testable code.
  • Collaborate with product, QA, frontend, and AI teams to ship features end-to-end.
  • Contribute to AI-powered modules (chatbots, search, recommendations, document processing) alongside senior engineers — full ownership grows with experience.
  • Work with senior developers on integrating Python services with our existing Java-based systems.

Mandatory Skills


  • Strong hands-on Python programming — OOP and data structures.
  • Experience building REST APIs with FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
  • Working knowledge of SQL (MySQL/PostgreSQL).
  • Good understanding of Git/version control.
  • Solid programming fundamentals, debugging, and problem-solving ability.

Preferred Skills (Good to Have)


You don't need to tick every box below — these are things we're happy to teach, and any exposure is a bonus:

  • Exposure to OpenAI APIs, LangChain, or Hugging Face.
  • Basic understanding of RAG, embeddings, or vector search (FAISS, Chroma, Pinecone).
  • Interest in or basic exposure to prompt engineering.
  • Familiarity with Pandas, NumPy, or Scikit-Learn.
  • Basic Docker knowledge.
  • Ability to read Java or Spring Boot code (not required to write it).
  • Exposure to background jobs, Celery, Redis, or schedulers.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Experience Required


  • 1–4 years of experience in Python backend development.
  • Candidates with a GitHub portfolio, personal AI projects, hackathon experience, or internships are welcomed even without formal AI job experience.
  • 3–4 year backend developers looking to move into AI-focused product work are strongly encouraged to apply.

Educational Qualification


B.E. / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience and a strong project portfolio will also be considered.


Why Join Us

  • Work on cutting-edge AI product features, not legacy maintenance.
  • Direct, hands-on exposure to LLMs and Generative AI tooling.
  • Learn from experienced product architects and senior engineers.
  • High ownership with fast-tracked career growth.
  • Product-based development for an enterprise platform used by large clients.
